selection: Two Commons dog photographs with source breed labels, one fixed low-resolution derivative, and two generated non-dog controls. Five inputs, four source groups. Convenience smoke evaluation; training overlap unknown. Demo beagle and derivatives excluded.
protocol: Run each baseline and agent once on identical decoded pixels, alternating order. Six action attempts, at most 240 seconds per photo. No follow-up photos in this evaluation; requested cases count as incomplete and abstaining. Label metrics include all three labeled inputs in their denominator, including abstentions and failures. Report selected-report top-1 separately from last classifier output. No threshold or prompt tuning on these cases. Synthetic controls measure false breed reports, not general non-dog detection.
